new_activity.author: greptile-apps
new_activity.body: Fallback picker misses its button When window.visualViewport is unavailable, _positionProjectPicker returns before setting left or capping the width. _showProjectPicker has already set right='auto', so the picker uses its default horizontal position instead of following the session button. Run the shared horizontal placement and width cap for the window-dimensions fallback too.

new_activity.author: greptile-apps
new_activity.body: Right-click picker stops following row On a touch-primary layout with a mouse, right-click stores _projectPickerContextPoint on the hidden actions element. _projectPickerAnchorRect keeps returning those original screen coordinates while the owning row remains visible. Scrolling the session list therefore leaves the picker at the old point instead of moving with its row. Store the point relative to the row and rebuild its screen coordinates from the current row position.

new_activity.author: greptile-apps
new_activity.body: Scroll close check gets lost scheduleReposition keeps the first event's closeWhenAway value. If a viewport event queues a frame and the session list then scrolls the anchor out of view before that frame runs, the scroll request is dropped. Placement runs with false and leaves the picker open for an offscreen row. Keep a pending close-check flag and combine later requests before running the frame.
